race.comment: RISING FORTUNE (7) resumes. Locally trained and outclassed on debut in a fairly strong contest when fourth over 1000m at Muswellbrook in the Star Kingdom last May. Looks to have strengthened over the break and his latest trial win here over 900m was sound. Gets his chance from the low gate. SHUDA KNOWN (5) tongue-tie goes on first up after he failed to make an impression in town in the first prep. Snagged back from the wide gate and offered little when tenth over 1100m at Randwick last June. Has looked sharp in the two trials and sure to be thereabouts. GIRL ABOUT TOWN (12) resumes. Bumped into a couple of handy types in her two career starts in town. Fitted with the one 1050m trial and kicks off in a suitable contest. CRIME OF PASSION (1) Zoustar mare resuming and now in the Cavanough yard. Finished off last campaign with a plugging third over 1100m at Pakenham Synthetic last July 20. Can pull out a big run fresh.
